name: CircleCI API
tagline: CI/CD API for pipelines, jobs, and project automation
description: CircleCI provides a REST API for managing continuous integration and delivery: pipelines, workflows, jobs, projects, contexts, and artifacts. Developers use personal or project API tokens to trigger builds, inspect status, and automate CI operations from scripts and tools.

auth.details: Personal or project API token via Circle-Token header (or query param). Self-serve account signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free: 30,000 credits/mo (~6,000 min on small Docker), 5 active users, 30 concurrent jobs, 1 GB network, 2 GB storage. Linux OSS: up to 400,000 credits/mo. Check pricing for current numbers.

rate_limits: Limits exist and vary by endpoint (no fixed public req/s). HTTP 429 with Retry-After; use RateLimit-*/X-RateLimit-* headers and exponential backoff. See API developer’s guide.
use_cases: trigger a pipeline for a branch
list recent jobs for a project
